title: Private Tour of Old Quebec – History and Hidden Treasures
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by at least one adult.
This is a private visit/activity. Only your group will participate.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore one of the most beautiful cities in North America on an exclusive private tour of Quebec City. Accompanied by an accredited and passionate local Guide, discover the iconic sights, fascinating history and anecdotes that have shaped this unique city.

Walking through the historic streets of famous Old Quebec, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, you will be immersed in more than 400 years of history. This personalized tour allows you to discover the city at your own pace, while enjoying captivating explanations and spectacular panoramas.

Your Guide will share with you the city’s secrets, landmarks, historical battles and local traditions. Whether you’re visiting Quebec City for the first time or want to learn more, this private tour will offer you an authentic and memorable experience.
